BioWheels Monday Night Tour de Indian Hill

Cincinnati, OH · Madeira · Road

No-drop

BioWheels Monday Night Tour de Indian Hill is a road group ride in Cincinnati, OH. It rolls every Monday at 6:00 pm from BioWheels Workshop. About 27.5 miles, b group 17–19 mph, C group 14–16 mph. No-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 17–19 mph: brisk — you'll want some fitness. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at @biowheels_workshop the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the BioWheels Monday Night Tour de Indian Hill group ride

A shop ride into Indian Hill with two hills and regroups at the top. Two speed groups led by volunteers. Route changes weekly.
